prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG decorative asset for the header of Écrinator, a polished French school writing app. Wide landscape 3:1 composition. A very subtle elegant layered frosted-white paper ribbon with gently curved tapered ends and a few thin pearl-white sweeping lines at the bottom right edge. True transparent alpha background, over 70 percent completely transparent negative space, especially left half and upper center. Pure white and pale neutral pearl only: no blue, grey filled background or saturated hue, so underlying different subject pastel colors remain accurate. Soft restrained dimensional highlights, crisp smooth edges, premium calm editorial design. Decoration concentrated in far right and bottom edges, no large rectangular panel, no border, no text, letters, icons, symbols, sparkle or watermark. This is a reusable background decoration behind editable text, NOT an app screenshot or complete banner. The central text region must remain entirely empty and transparent.
